subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should newly discovered persona TTS SecretRefs remain startup-required when their value is missing, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy?
rationale: The collection fix is correct, but activating previously ignored credential paths changes the failure boundary for existing configurations and can turn an optional TTS credential into a Gateway startup blocker.

options.title: Prove and keep fail-closed
options.body: Require exact-head live resolution proof, then merge while explicitly accepting that missing persona TTS credentials remain startup-fatal pending separate policy work.

options.title: Sequence after degradation policy
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 or another approved design localizes missing optional TTS credential failures.

recommendation.title: Prove and keep fail-closed
recommendation.body: Require exact-head live resolution proof, then merge while explicitly accepting that missing persona TTS credentials remain startup-fatal pending separate policy work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest ownership across TTS runtime, per-agent overrides, provider behavior, and command resolution.
